//: The player starts with empty pockets and guaranteed supplies on the starting ground.

tutorial.//: The guided first day (game/tutorial/Tutorial.js). `recipe`/`materials`: the carrying craft. `second`: one more craft right after it. `drink` and `food`: one small thing each, found by the first search, for the consuming lesson (the food is neither raw nor a parasite risk). `painkiller`: carried into the first fight. `hq.hearth`: the station the headquarters lesson points at after the first shelter stands.
tutorial.//lessons: Prologue rule (07.10.2026): the first-time lessons after the guide (src/game/tutorial/Lessons.js) start at these lines: lowWaterBelow and lowFoodBelow are shares of the water and food bars, moodBelow a mood level (practice.json morale.levelCap bounds it), wetAbove a share of soaked, overloadedAbove a share of the carrying weight limit, wornBelow a share of a wielded tool's condition.

optionalGoals.title: Find water
optionalGoals.summary: Find a river or lake. Water can usually be found near where you woke up.

optionalGoals.title: Make a base
optionalGoals.summary: Choose an explored tile and use Build HQ. It is highly recommended to build near a river or lake; water can usually be found near your starting area.

optionalGoals.title: Carry supplies
optionalGoals.summary: Make and wear a carrying item. Crafting shows the materials you need.

optionalGoals.title: Keep a cutting tool
optionalGoals.summary: Keep a tool with Cutting 1 or better in your supplies.

optionalGoals.title: Keep spare cordage
optionalGoals.summary: Make or find cordage for your next tools and repairs.

optionalGoals.title: Prepare wound care
optionalGoals.summary: Keep a clean bandage ready before exploring farther.

optionalGoals.title: Build a hearth
optionalGoals.summary: At HQ, open Buildings and build a fire ring for cooking and warmth.

optionalGoals.title: Carry a water container
optionalGoals.summary: Keep a bottle or another container that can hold water.

optionalGoals.title: Store safe drinking water
optionalGoals.summary: Keep clean water in your inventory or at HQ.

optionalGoals.title: Find cookware
optionalGoals.summary: Keep a tool with Boiling 1 or better for preparing safe water.

optionalGoals.title: Set food aside
optionalGoals.summary: Keep some food in your pack or at HQ.

optionalGoals.title: Learn survival
optionalGoals.summary: Reach Survival level 1 by exploring and gathering.

optionalGoals.title: Learn fabrication
optionalGoals.summary: Reach Fabrication level 1 by crafting or practising.

optionalGoals.title: Learn tailoring
optionalGoals.summary: Reach Tailoring level 1 by crafting or practising.

optionalGoals.title: Keep a hammering tool
optionalGoals.summary: Keep a tool with Hammering 2 or better for more construction recipes.

optionalGoals.title: Know your surroundings
optionalGoals.summary: Explore at least 10 tiles. Check nearby terrain before travelling farther.

optionalGoals.title: Find a book
optionalGoals.summary: Find and keep a book. Its details show what it teaches or offers for reading.

optionalGoals.title: Learn cooking
optionalGoals.summary: Reach Cooking level 1 through recipes or practice.

optionalGoals.title: Improve your cutting tool
optionalGoals.summary: Keep a tool with Cutting 2 or better to unlock more recipes.

optionalGoals.title: Prepare to dig
optionalGoals.summary: Keep a tool with Digging 1 or better for outdoor work.

optionalGoals.title: Build endurance
optionalGoals.summary: Reach Athletics level 1 through travelling, searching and giving ground.

optionalGoals.title: Develop your camp
optionalGoals.summary: Build at least 3 different stations at HQ, including your shelter.

optionalGoals.title: Explore the wider world
optionalGoals.summary: Explore at least 25 tiles. Keep water, food and medical supplies ready for the journey.
